name: Crux Hero
body:
Prerequisites: 5th-level crux, at least 2 levels in non-crux classes.

Benefit: You gain a new oscillation.

At 11th level, your store opposition improves by 1, to a maximum of 4. If you are an 11th-level or higher crux, you gain trinity opposition at 20th level (your additional spell is limited to your highest level of discharge).
